question: Gangotri Glacier lies in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gangotri Glacier is located in the **Uttarkashi district **of** Uttarakhand state** in India.
 
• It is one of the** primary sources **of the Ganges river and is situated at an altitude of **4,100 meters** above sea level.
 
• The glacier is a popular** trekking destination** and attracts a large number of tourists every year.
 
• Gangotri Glacier is also a site of religious significance, and many pilgrims visit the place as a part of the **Chota Char Dham Yatra. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) **Arunachal Pradesh: Arunachal Pradesh is a state in** Northeast India**.

 
 
• It is known for its scenic beauty and is home to many** glaciers and snow-capped mountains**. However, Gangotri Glacier is not located in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Option 3)** Himachal Pradesh: Himachal Pradesh is another state in** North India** known for its picturesque landscapes and mountain ranges.
 
 
• However, Gangotri Glacier is not located in Himachal Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Option 4)** Sikkim: Sikkim is a small state in **Northeast** India located in the Himalayas.
 
 
• It is known for its natural beauty and is home to **many glaciers and snow-capped mountains.**
 
• However, Gangotri Glacier is not located in Sikkim.
 
 
 
• Hence, the statement "Gangotri Glacier lies in which state?" is **correctly a**nswered by option 2, Uttarakhand.
